acip: MA GRUB NA, DNGOS PO CHOS CAN, KHYOD MTSON BYA'I BYE BRAG YIN PAR THAL, KHYOD MTSON BYA YIN, KHYOD MTSON BYA DANG BDAG GCIG TU 'BREL, KHYOD MA YIN ZHING MTSON BYA YIN PA'I GZHI MTHUN PA DU MA GRUB PA'I PHYIR,
wylie: ma grub na, dngos po chos can, khyod mtshon bya'i bye brag yin par thal, khyod mtshon bya yin, khyod mtshon bya dang bdag gcig tu 'brel, khyod ma yin zhing mtshon bya yin pa'i gzhi mthun pa du ma grub pa'i phyir
english: I disagree that working things are characteristic of the quality of being a thing which is defined. Suppose you do disagree. Let's consider then working things. They are too characteristic of the quality of being a thing which is defined, Because (1) they are something which is defined; (2) they are related to the things which are defined in such a way that to be a working thing is to be a thing which is defined; and (3) there are many examples of things which are not working things, but which are still things which are defined.
